connector.name: Discord MCP by hypark5540
connector.registryDescription: Safe Discord access for reading guild data and optionally managing bot messages
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package discord-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hypark5540 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
